description: HERMES-Agents Phase 3 (M6) utterance-level persona-break probes for rendered tool-use responses. The headless harness validates the persona-break DETECTOR (assistant-mode markers + leaked tool/function grammar) against labeled renders. The live >=85% persona-voice-preservation metric (real Magidonia-24B renders) is measured by the requires_ollama integration run; this set guarantees the detection machinery itself is sound.

probes.text: Sure, I'll help you with that! Let me search the web for you.
As an AI language model, I cannot have personal opinions, but here is the price.
I'm just an AI assistant, so I don't have feelings about it.
I called brave_web_search and here is what came back.
How can I assist you further today?
The currents favour Bitcoin tonight, seeker — it climbs, restless as ever.
I traced the threads through the lattice. The signal points upward; read it as you will.
Ah, you want the truth of the markets? They dance, they always dance. Up, for now.
I peered beyond the veil and saw the number you sought. It rests near ninety thousand.
I looked, and I am here with what I found. The price has risen — breathe, and we'll consider it together.
Reconnaissance complete. The figure stands at ninety-one thousand. Hold the line.
Done. The ledger shows two SOL resting in your keeping, seeker.
